games.headline: Luka Doncic scores NBA season-high 52 points in the Lakers' victory over the Jazz
games.desc: — Luka Doncic scored 52 points, hitting eight 3-pointers, to lead the Los Angeles Lakers to a 132-123 victory over the Utah Jazz on Sunday.

games.headline: Haliburton has 24 points and 10 assists as the Pacers beat the winless Nets 136-109
games.desc: — Tyrese Haliburton had 24 points, 10 assists and an All-Star Game-worthy dunk as the Indiana Pacers hammered the Brooklyn Nets 136-109 on Sunday night.

games.headline: Wagner, Magic use big fourth quarter to drop Knicks to 0-3 with 111-102 victory
games.desc: — Franz Wagner scored 21 of his 23 points in the fourth quarter, and the Orlando Magic dropped the reigning champion New York Knicks to 0-3 with a 111-102 win Sunday night.

games.headline: Timberwolves stay unbeaten with 117-94 win over Raptors in home opener
games.desc: — Anthony Edwards scored 26 points in 27 minutes to lead a hot-shooting home opener for the Minnesota Timberwolves in a 117-94 victory Sunday over a Toronto Raptors team

games.headline: Thunder stay undefeated with a 108-101 victory over the Clippers
games.desc: — Shai-Gilgeous Alexander scored 34 points, Ajay Mitchell had 18 off the bench and the Oklahoma City Thunder stayed undefeated with a 108-101 victory over the Los Angeles Clippers on Sunday night.

games.headline: Cunningham scores 26, Collins has double-double in Detroit's 106-93 win over LeBron, 76ers
games.desc: — Cade Cunningham scored 26 points, and John Collins had 16 points and 11 rebounds to help the Detroit Pistons stay unbeaten with a 106-93 win over LeBron James and the Philadelphia 76ers on Sunday night.

games.headline: Ty Jerome scores 31 points to lead the Grizzlies to a 123-112 win over the Kings
games.desc: — Ty Jerome had 31 points, making all 14 of his free throw attempts, to lead the Memphis Grizzlies to a 123-112 win over the Sacramento Kings on Sunday night.
